EasyShot M6 recognition dependencies

https://github.com/BobLd/RapidOcrNet
Based on RapidAI/RapidOCR and portions of PdfPig; contour processing derives
from LingDong-/PContour and BobLd/PContourNet. See their upstream notices.

https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR

  onnx/PP-OCRv4/det/ch_PP-OCRv4_det_mobile.onnx
  onnx/PP-OCRv4/cls/ch_ppocr_mobile_v2.0_cls_mobile.onnx
